Tabs.purpose: Render a horizontal tablist and its associated panels. Left and Right (RTL-aware), Home and End move focus and activate a tab, skipping disabled tabs.

variant.description: Use natural tab widths or distribute tabs across the available width.

id.description: Root ID and base for generated tab and panel IDs. Defaults to a unique per-instance ID, so repeated tablists with the same label never collide. Required in composed mode: pass the same value as tabsId to each Tab and TabPanel.

tabs.description: Optional data-driven mode. Use distinct string values and name each panel slot after its value. Omit tabs to compose Tab and TabPanel children.

value.description: Initially selected tab, matched to the value of a Tab or data item. Browser interactions manage selection after rendering.

content: With tabs: one named slot per tab value. Without tabs: default slot contains Tab components, and the panels slot contains TabPanel components. In composed mode pass an explicit id and use it as tabsId on each child.
events: clay-change: bubbling CustomEvent<{ value: string | number }> on the Tabs root after a user changes the selection; event.detail.value preserves the Tab's value type.

examples.title: Track the selected tab

value.description: Selected tab value. Supports bind:value; when omitted, no tab starts selected.

onChange.description: Optional callback (event: Event, value: string | number) => void. Called when the user selects a different tab, not for parent-driven value changes.

content: children: render Tab components inside the tablist.
panels: a Svelte snippet containing TabPanel components, rendered after the tablist.
events: onChange(event, value): selection callback for user changes only.

Tab.purpose: Render a tab button inside Tabs. Pair it with a TabPanel of the same value.

value.description: Selection key. Match a TabPanel value exactly, including type: 2 and "2" are different tabs.

selected.description: Set on the tab matching Tabs.value for first paint. The browser controller then manages selection.

content: icon: optional named slot before the label.
events: Listen for clay-change on Tabs, not on each Tab.

examples.title: Tab with a panel
examples.source:
---
const tabsId = 'settings-tabs';
---
<Tabs id={tabsId} aria-label="Settings" value="preferences">
  <Tab tabsId={tabsId} value="preferences" label="Preferences" selected />
  <Tab tabsId={tabsId} value="billing" label="Billing" />
  <Fragment slot="panels">
    <TabPanel tabsId={tabsId} value="preferences" selected>Choose your preferences.</TabPanel>
    <TabPanel tabsId={tabsId} value="billing">Manage billing.</TabPanel>
  </Fragment>
</Tabs>

content: icon: an optional Svelte snippet rendered before the label. No default children.
events: onclick and onkeydown: native button handlers run before selection or keyboard navigation respectively. Calling event.preventDefault() skips that built-in behavior.

TabPanel.purpose: Render the content for a matching Tab. Unselected panels stay mounted but hidden.

value.description: Match the corresponding Tab value exactly.

selected.description: Show this panel at first paint when its value matches Tabs.value.

content: default slot: panel content. Put the panel in Tabs' panels slot.

examples.title: Panel with numeric value
examples.source:
---
const tabsId = 'report-tabs';
---
<Tabs id={tabsId} aria-label="Reports" value={1}>
  <Tab tabsId={tabsId} value={1} label="Summary" selected />
  <TabPanel slot="panels" tabsId={tabsId} value={1} selected>Report summary</TabPanel>
</Tabs>

Dialog.purpose: Render a native modal dialog with focus trapping and an inert background. Use title or supply an accessible name with aria-label or aria-labelledby.

title.description: Optional visible heading used as the dialog's accessible name.

open.description: Svelte: live modal state, supports bind:open. Astro: request initial modal opening once the client script runs.

fullWidth.description: Fill the available width up to maxWidth.

maxWidth.description: Maximum width: xs = 320px, sm = 444px, md = 600px, each capped by the viewport.

dismissible.description: Show a close (X) button in the top corner. It requests close with reason closeButton, like Escape and backdrop clicks.

closeText.description: Accessible name of the close button.

id.description: Unique dialog ID. Native buttons target it with commandfor and command="show-modal" or command="close".

content: actions: optional named slot for buttons and other actions.
events: clay-request-close: cancelable, non-bubbling CustomEvent on the dialog for Escape, backdrop clicks or the close (X) button. event.detail.reason is escapeKeyDown, backdropClick or closeButton. Call event.preventDefault() to keep the dialog open; a native close command does not send this request.

onClose.description: Optional callback (event: Event, reason: 'escapeKeyDown' | 'backdropClick' | 'closeButton') => void. For these requests, set open to false to accept, or leave it unchanged to reject. Without the callback the dialog closes itself.

content: actions: optional Svelte snippet for buttons and other actions.
events: onClose(event, reason): handles Escape, backdrop and close-button requests. If the browser already closed the dialog (for example via a form with method="dialog"), the binding is resynced and an installed callback receives escapeKeyDown even if Escape did not cause the close.
